About

Quick Facts

  • Based in

    Chicago, IL

  • Primary role

    Bassist

  • Endorsements

    D'Addario, Gallien-Krueger

Trevor Jones is a Chicago-based bassist and co-founder of Double Bass HQ. He serves as House Bassist and Music Coordinator at the Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire, IL, — see his credits. He also freelances widely across the Chicago area and writes and performs in the alternative rock band Molehill, which has toured nationally and earned coverage in the Chicago Tribune.

Trevor endorses Gallien-Krueger amplifiers and cabinets and is a D'Addario Artist.
